  "notes": "Monarch gene–disease links come from curated sources such as OMIM, Orphanet and ClinVar, carrying ECO codes that mix manual and automatic assertion. The rows do not separate causal from correlative links, so I used gene_associated_with_condition rather than a causal predicate. Agent type is not_provided because the evidence is mixed.
